units.source_text: 平安时代里巷间弹琵琶的盲僧，称为琵琶法师。

en.t: In the Heian period, blind monks who played the biwa in the streets and lanes were called biwa hoshi.

units.source_text: 后世以弹琵琶说《平家物语》为业的盲人，亦称为琵琶法师。

en.t: In later generations, blind people who made a living by playing the biwa and reciting The Tale of the Heike were also called biwa hoshi.
